speaker: Daniel
text: The Chang'e-4 mission carried instruments that had been developed by scientists from Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, and Saudi Arabia, providing more opportunities for the world's scientists and combining human wisdom to explore the universe. Now China is drawing up plans to explore the moon's polar regions and inviting other countries to join in further expeditions. “I think one of the beauties of space science is that we do cooperate internationally. Space science to me is something important, also as a message of peace worldwide,” said a German professor in the program.
